hooks.name: Schema & Contract Sync Guard
hooks.description: When backend schemas or API contracts change, ensure the full chain stays in sync.

action.prompt:
A schema or contract file was modified. Complete the sync chain:
1. If schemas.py changed: update the matching OpenAPI contract in contracts/ and the mobile DTOs in mobile/.../shared/models/.
2. If a contract changed: update backend schemas.py to match and regenerate mobile DTOs.
3. Verify: all new fields have Pydantic constraints (ge, le, min_length). Input models use extra='forbid'.
4. Verify: no breaking changes to existing response shapes (field removals or type changes) without explicit confirmation.
5. If a new endpoint was added: ensure it's registered in the api/v1/router.py.
